title: Per-Tenant Audit-Chain Slicing Canonical Spec
purpose: Operationalizes ADR-0162. Declares the per-tenant audit-chain partition scheme, sovereign-tenant dedicated-shard contract, sealing cadence, and per-tenant retrieval API.

shared_shard_per_pack.structure: per-pack Merkle tree; tenant_id is a leaf-level partition; per-tenant subtree retrieval O(log n)

dedicated_shard_per_sovereign_tenant.applies_to: packs marked dedicated_audit_shard: true (pack-ksa, pack-uae, pack-eu-sovereign, pack-ru-if-onboarded)
dedicated_shard_per_sovereign_tenant.structure: per-tenant Merkle tree; in-region storage + key custody + sealing

sharding_scheme.per_cell_sharding: tenant pinned to cell stores leaves in that cell's shard; intra-region DR replicates

sealing_cadence.subtree_root_seal: every hour (per-tenant subtree root recomputed + Ed25519-signed)
sealing_cadence.daily_root_anchor: per-pack root anchored to immutable storage (oya-s3-cold per ADR-0161) daily
sealing_cadence.fleet_wide_root: global root computed daily; published to trust portal (ADR-0038)

sealing_key_custody.dedicated_shard: per-tenant in-region HSM partition (per ADR-0043 + ADR-0164 air-gap variant)

per_tenant_retrieval_api.cedar_gate: principal.tenant_id == path.tenant_id (tenant can only read its own seals; cross-tenant requires explicit Cedar grant)
per_tenant_retrieval_api.inclusion_proof_option: ?proof=true returns Merkle inclusion proof per seal
per_tenant_retrieval_api.dsr_cascade_safe: seal contains hashes + metadata only; PII fields zeroed per ADR-0008 DUBO

constraints: shard storage in-cell only (no cross-cell beyond intra-region DR)
shard encryption key custody in-region HSM
shard sealing private key in-region HSM
shard deletion on tenant offboarding leaves no residue in other tenants' shards
cross-shard verification (fleet-wide root) published in-region only for sovereign-pinned tenants

microservice_topology.cell_hosts: per-pack shared shard + dedicated sovereign-tenant shards
